findings.finding: Reusable-holdout theory shows that adaptively selecting later analyses using prior results on the same holdout can invalidate ordinary fixed-procedure guarantees even if each individual analysis is otherwise clean.
sources: Dwork et al., STOC 2015, Preserving Statistical Validity in Adaptive Data Analysis
